title: Be careful- great the 2 times it was used
text: Be careful- great the 2 times it was used. I loved this vacuum for the 2 times I used it. I was upset the return window has just closed when it crapped out. I did love this vacuum- good suction, you don't have to hold the button down and it has a light. It had everything I wanted for our travel trailer. The second time I used it i noticed a burning smell and then it wouldn't charge. It really is a bummer since it was not cheap and I can't afford to just buy another one. Be careful

[Power Technology]: The upgrade version provides 175-watt powerful suction to meet every cleaning demands, picks up debris and dusts, crumbs and pet hairs in minute. It performs well on all kinds of hard floors, carpet, stairs and windowsills, sofa and bed, desk and curtain, etc.

[Root Cyclone Technology]: The filtering effect is 40-60% better than the general vacuum cleaner. When you use a S12 cordless vacuum, multi-cone cyclones help separate dust and air more effectively, centrifuge through multiple filter holes to achieve perfect results, and avoid secondary pollution.

[Self-standing]: Need not to drill the bracket into the wall for hanging, also needn't lean against a wall, stand the vacuum anywhere when you're tired. Besides, the attachments storage rack could be clamped on the tube for saving space.

[Battery Saving Technology]: With low mode, the S12 cordless vacuum has 40 minutes of battery life. Our unique battery saving technology ensures that the suction of the vacuum cleaner is always in a state of high power and low power loss.

[Lightweight + Detachable Battery]: The main machine weights only 4.8lb which can be equipped with different attachments for different tasks. Buying a spare battery doubles the battery life, up to 80 minutes of running time, no waiting for charging.
